name: Kiln (procedural 3D assets via coding agents)
summary: Open-source local MCP server, CLI and TypeScript engine that lets a coding agent (Codex, Claude Code, etc.) build and revise procedural 3D assets: editable source, rendered review images and GLB export. Runs locally with no account; your agent supplies the model. v1.6.0 released Oct 27, 2026; the Holodeck demo (CC0 assets) is built with it.

access.price: $0 (local); hosted Kiln is a free invite-only beta
access.notes: Local Kiln is free and account-free. Requires Node.js 22 or 24 LTS. KTX2 texture export needs the optional ktx2-encoder peer (MIT). Hosted Kiln is invite-only via Discord, not required.

procedure: mkdir kiln-install && cd kiln-install && npm init -y && npm install @instruktlabs/kiln
Run npx --offline --no -- kiln-init ../my-assets --harness codex (or your agent harness)
Open the asset workspace with your coding agent; Kiln connects over MCP and exports GLB

verdict.why: MIT, local and account-free, ~300 stars and actively released; directly useful for agent-driven procedural game assets with GLB output. Young project from a small team, so expect API churn.
